title: Newton: saucer settled gently within 500 miles of Denver
summary: Silus Newton tells of Newton: saucer settled gently within 500 miles of Denver, about 1948 (told 1950) at within 500 miles of Denver, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Within 500 m of the city of Denver, there settled gently to Earth a round object which had already been identified as being a flying saucer.

plain: A man named Silas Newton said in 1950 that in 1948 a round object, already identified as a flying saucer, settled gently to Earth within 500 miles of Denver. If true, it would mean a craft from elsewhere came down whole and was recovered.
